Add OSM tags as columns

Source: R/functions.R
nyc_osm_add_tags.Rd

Extracts the values of one or more OSM tag keys from the tags column into new character columns. Works on the lazy data frames returned by the nyc_osm functions (the extraction runs in DuckDB) and on collected data frames.

Usage

nyc_osm_add_tags(df, keys)

Arguments

df

A data frame with a tags column, lazy or collected.

keys

Character vector of OSM tag keys, e.g. "diet:vegan", "roof:shape".

Value

df with one character column per key, named after the key with characters other than letters, digits, and underscores replaced by _ ("diet:vegan" becomes diet_vegan). NA where the tag is absent.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
library(dplyr)

nyc_osm_points() |>
  filter(amenity == "restaurant") |>
  nyc_osm_add_tags(c("diet:vegan", "outdoor_seating")) |>
  filter(diet_vegan %in% c("yes", "only")) |>
  select(name, cuisine, diet_vegan, outdoor_seating) |>
  collect()
} # }
